name: wfgraph
description: Workflow Graph — visual workflow automation with a node-based editor and plugin integrations

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,client,inngest --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm run dev:app" "pnpm --filter @wfgraph/client dev" "pnpm run dev:inngest"
scripts.dev:inngest: sh -c 'if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/inngest ]; then DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ./node_modules/.bin/inngest dev --no-discovery -p 8388 --connect-gateway-port 8390 --connect-gateway-grpc-port 50062 --connect-executor-grpc-port 50063 --persist; else echo "[inngest] inngest-cli is not installed; examples/app.ts sets inngest.connect, so dev:app will fail to boot once its Connect handshake times out"; fi'
scripts.db:generate: pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --config packages/core/drizzle.config.ts && tsx scripts/unqualify-migrations.ts
